It emphasizes the importance of appreciating what Allah has granted and not being attracted to material possessions beyond what is necessary, as excess desires can lead to sadness and discontentment. This spiritual quality is fostered through various facets of Islamic culture, such as the practice of daily prayers, striving for self-improvement, and cultivating a strong connection to Allah.
